title: DE RIGO
subtitle: Audacity Land
description:
Immersive digital engagement through interactive 3D environments.
A WebGL-based digital experience featuring dedicated 3D spaces for three product categories: watches, eyewear, and fragrances. Users join the platform through a personalized community token (NFT) generated from their profile responses.
Inside the experience, users complete guided missions, interact with 3D product objects, and accumulate points while discovering new collections within a gamified environment designed to increase engagement and brand interaction.
